notes.title: [July 20] More build-in songs & Make login async
notes.content:
[i]Is some apple making you [b]quit and uninstall[/b]?[/i]
I added some [b][i]EASY[/i][/b] ones [b][i]JUST FOR YOU[/i][/b] (for now)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33126096/b6199a2f811e211db6bd915b967700ff5a8beb38.jpg[/img]

[spoiler]The image is blurred just in case.[/spoiler]

Ohhh, yes yes yes! Who like that login panel which [strike]diligently helps you record your scores[/strike]?
I made that annoying thing not blocking the song select.
Now you can just ignore it [b]without explicitly select Cancel[/b]!

notes.title: [System] About how to add songs
notes.content:
1. Go to a popular beatmap listing website
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33126096/de3c83246ea2913d81b05c6e1192575c7fe0deaf.jpg[/img]

2. Download .osz file of your preferred beatmap
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33126096/75a96c76a2f980ef166c394d0d0967dfa9f08e1f.jpg[/img]

3. Put the downloaded .osz file to [b]C:\Users\[i]<your user name>[/i]\AppData\LocalLow\Nezphere\Envoy of Nezphere[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33126096/81eba0083f0a98bcbd621e9e95aa2991f6c7d951.jpg[/img]

4. Open game, the beatmaps are loaded and ready to be played.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33126096/9e2bb5e4c5fedf8468f84d0065ce05bc80c851f6.png[/img]

[spoiler]Images are blurred to respect the rights of the contents' copyright owners[/spoiler]

notes.title: [July 17] Disable resolution popup & Ditch CJK ratings
notes.content:
1. Disable resolution popup so that after opening the game, VR will not stuck.
2. Ditch Chinese/Japanese character [b]in the accuracy indicator[/b] [i](the titles are still in their native languages)[/i]. Now using [b]Σ for Perfect, Θ for Great, Ψ for Good, and Γ for Bad[/b].
